summary: Frontend retest for TeachHub. All 13 requested flows verified against the live REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Protected-route loading-race fix confirmed: hard-navigation to /publish, /profile, /admin after login now correctly renders the pages without redirecting to /login. Full E2E flows (publish, edit, delete, like, favorite, report, admin moderation, pagination, filters, guest redirects) all pass.

issues: Dev-only React hydration warning: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' originates from the visual-edits babel wrapper injecting a <span data-ve-dynamic> inside <option> in Feed.jsx subject/grade selects. As flagged by main agent, this is a harmless dev-mode warning caused by tooling instrumentation, not app code. Should not appear in production build.
Radix DialogContent missing Description / aria-describedby — a11y warning only.

critical_code_review_comments: AuthContext.js: fetch to /auth/me does not check for 401 explicitly — any error clears token, which is fine but could log real network errors for debuggability.
Publish.jsx form uses native <select> with i18n options — this is fine and expected; the hydration warning is from visual-edits tooling, not real code.
seed_data_creation: Created & deleted one E2E test task during the flow. Created + dismissed one report. No residual test data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All frontend flows currently green on preview URL. If retesting, note that AssignmentCard uses data-testid='assignment-card-{id}' (NOT task-card-*). Pagination confirmed 10 on page 1, 5 on page 2 (15 seeded tasks). Admin users-table is only visible after clicking admin-tab-users tab.
